-health-check.name: -health-check
-health-check.description: Internal health check tool. Verifies WebSocket connectivity to backend.

search-messages.name: search-messages
search-messages.description: Search for text in messages across all past conversations. Returns matches grouped by channel with context snippets.

params.query: Text to search for (case-insensitive, minimum 2 characters)
params.limit: Maximum number of results to return (default: 50, max: 100)

list-channels.name: list-channels
list-channels.description: List past conversations. Returns channel names, agents, and last message preview.

params.limit: Maximum number of channels to return (default: 20)

get-channel-messages.name: get-channel-messages
get-channel-messages.description: Get messages from a specific past conversation. Supports pagination.

params.channelId: The ID of the channel to get messages from
params.before: Message ID for pagination - get messages before this one
params.textOnly: Only return text messages, excluding tool executions (default: true)

get-channel-summary.name: get-channel-summary
get-channel-summary.description: Get a quick summary of a conversation without all messages. Useful to understand what a conversation was about.

params.channelId: The ID of the channel to summarize

create-conversation.name: create-conversation
create-conversation.description: Create a new conversation with a specific agent. Returns the new channel ID that can be used to send messages.

params.agentId: The ID of the agent to start a conversation with
params.name: Optional name for the conversation

delegate-task.name: delegate-task
delegate-task.description: Delegate a task to a new sub-conversation with an agent (defaults to yourself). Creates the conversation, sends the task prompt, and returns immediately. The sub-agent works independently and each of its responses is automatically forwarded back to this conversation.

params.prompt: Full task description and instructions to send to the sub-agent
params.agentId: Agent ID to delegate to. Defaults to the current agent (self-delegation).
params.taskName: Optional name for the delegated task conversation

send-message.name: send-message
send-message.description: Send a message to an existing conversation. The agent will process and respond to the message.

params.channelId: The ID of the channel to send the message to

rename-channel.name: rename-channel
rename-channel.description: Rename a conversation. Changes the title/name of a channel.

params.channelId: The ID of the channel to rename
params.name: The new name/title for the conversation

import-attachment.name: import-attachment
import-attachment.description: Copy a file the user uploaded in chat (image or document) into the agent workspace volume so filesystem tools can read it. Identify it by the filename shown in the "[User sent ...]" message reference. Returns { workspacePath, size, mime }.

params.filename: Filename of the chat attachment to import, as shown in the message reference
params.destPath: Optional destination path inside the workspace (relative). Defaults to the original filename at the workspace root.
params.channelId: Channel to import from. Defaults to the current conversation.
params.messageId: Optional message ID to disambiguate when several attachments share a filename.
params.overwrite: Overwrite the destination if it already exists (default: false).

name: Conversations
description: Access and search past conversations and messages from the database

changelog.notes: Initial release — search and read past conversations, start chats, send messages, delegate tasks to agents, and import files
